value.body: A two-year master's after B.V.Sc & A.H. in a specialisation such as veterinary medicine, surgery, pathology, microbiology, animal genetics and breeding, animal nutrition or livestock production. It includes coursework and a research thesis, and is offered by state veterinary and agricultural universities and ICAR institutes.

items.label: Students enrolled
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, programme-wise enrolment, all modes (Ministry of Education)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: B.V.Sc & A.H. with the minimum marks the university sets. ICAR's AIEEA-PG, conducted by NTA, fills seats in ICAR institutes and a share of seats in state universities; the remaining seats go through each university's own entrance test or merit list.

value.title: At a glance
items: It leads to research, teaching (usually with a Ph.D. and NET), state animal husbandry services, and industry roles in animal health, feed and diagnostics.
Fellowships and stipends depend on the admission route and the state.
A Ph.D. is usually expected for university teaching posts.
